page_title: BRE 3-3 LIL | Brest v Lille 17/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' PENALTY APPEAL after Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90+7' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
90+6' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Kamory Doumbia will be replaced by Luc Zogbe (Brest).
90+3' What a sweet touch by Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Radoslaw Majecki to hold.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Mama Balde makes his way off the pitch and Hamidou Makalou (Brest) comes on as his replacement.
88' Clement Turpin blows his whistle. Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) commits a foul after dangerous play.
85' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
85' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) replacing Ngalayel Mukau.
85' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
84' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest). Lille earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
82' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is flagged for offside.

79' A sweet pass finds Romain Del Castillo (Brest) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Berke Ozer is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
77' A rebound falls at the feet of Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.

75' 3 - 3 A good lofted pass from Kenny Lala finds Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which ends up in the roof of the net. The score is now 3:3.
73' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
72' A substitution has been made. Romain Perraud goes off and Vincent Burlet (Lille) comes on.
68' Referee Clement Turpin signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Lille players have a reason to celebrate!
68' The Lille players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
66' 2 - 3 Goal 2:3! Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
66' Lille have been awarded a corner kick.

66' That was a wasted opportunity to score by Romain Perraud (Lille). He picks up the rebound and produces a poor effort which is easily saved by the goalkeeper. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lille are going to take it.
65' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
64' Olivier Giroud (Lille) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
62' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

62' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.

60' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Radoslaw Majecki has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
59' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
57' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
52' Ousmane Toure is substituted due to injury. Bruno Genesio gives a chance to Adeagan Goffi (Lille).
51' 2 - 2 Goal! Mama Balde pulls the ball back for Kamory Doumbia (Brest) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the top right corner. 2:2.
50' Clement Turpin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Julien Le Cardinal (Brest).

47' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Berke Ozer. This effort didn't really trouble him.
46' Bruno Genesio has made a change at the break. Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) has come on in place of Marius Broholm.
46' The whistle blows and Clement Turpin starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+5' Marius Broholm (Lille) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
45+5' Mama Balde (Brest) tackles a bit over-zealously and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
45+4' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
45+3' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) was too forceful with his tackle and Clement Turpin interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

45+2' Olivier Giroud (Lille) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Radoslaw Majecki, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Marius Broholm (Lille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
44' Marius Broholm (Lille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
43' OFF THE POST! Good play from Mama Balde (Brest) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes against the crossbar!
42' Mama Balde (Brest) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
40' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

40' Olivier Giroud (Lille) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Lille get a corner.
37' Olivier Giroud (Lille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
35' The game is interrupted now, Olivier Giroud (Lille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
34' 1 - 2 Goal! Kamory Doumbia (Brest) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:2.
34' Wow, what an escape. Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
32' Olivier Giroud (Lille) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
31' Romain Perraud (Lille) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. It's a throw-in for Brest.
28' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
26' 0 - 2 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:2.
25' Berke Ozer leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Romain Del Castillo (Brest).

25' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Brest have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
22' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
21' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and it's Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
18' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Clement Turpin had an easy-decision to make.
17' Mama Balde (Brest) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
16' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
16' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nathan Ngoy (Lille) was quite harsh and Clement Turpin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
15' Lille are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Felix Correia shows great vision to find Olivier Giroud (Lille) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
9' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
8' The resulting corner, taken by Romain Del Castillo (Brest), comes to nothing.

8' A lofted cross from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The linesman makes the right call and Brest will have a corner.
6' The percentage of ball possession is – 16:84.
3' Lille keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession. The ball is out of play. Brest will have a throw-in.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Lille will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
